players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Solo HR in the 4th inning in Seattle's 3-2 win at St. Louis, completing the series sweep.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: 2-for-4, 2 R, 4 RBI; tiebreaking single in the 10th as Phillies snapped 10-game losing streak 8-5 over Atlanta.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: SAC bunt and fielder's choice RBI in Giants' 6-3 win over Miami; Landen Roupp dominated with 7.2 scoreless IP.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: 1-for-5 (with 2 BB) in SS debut filling in for Lindor; Mets swept by Colorado in doubleheader 3-1, 3-0.

players.name: Francisco Lindor
players.summary: On 10-day IL with left calf strain; in walking boot, won't be re-evaluated for 3 weeks, expected out until early June.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: 1-for-3 with a walk and 2 Ks as Cubs were blanked 6-0 by the Dodgers. Was heavily booed at Dodger Stadium.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: 2-for-4 in Padres' 12-7 Mexico City loss; D-backs rallied from a 6-run deficit to complete the series split.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: 2-for-3, 2 R, 2 RBI; two-RBI single sparked the Dodgers' 6-run 4th inning en route to a 6-0 shutout of the Cubs.

players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Missed 2nd straight game with right calf tightness; Yankees IL decision expected Monday April 27.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: 1 IP, 0 ER in Mets' doubleheader; no save opportunities as Mets dropped both games to Colorado.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: 2026 season debut: 5 IP, 3 H, 2 ER, 6 K, 3 BB (ND) in Phillies' 8-5 extra-inning win vs Atlanta; 15 whiffs generated.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: First win of 2026: 6 IP, 1 ER, 11 K, 0 BB in Royals' 12-1 blowout of the Angels. Was 0-5 in first 5 starts.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Did not pitch April 26; Reds hosted Detroit with a different starter. Burns maintaining 1.62 ERA through 3 starts.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Best start of 2026: 7 shutout IP, 7 K, 2 BB (W) vs Athletics. ERA improves from 5.79 to 4.70.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Did not start April 26; Wrobleski got the nod in Dodgers' 6-0 win vs Cubs. Sheehan working through mechanical issues.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: 5.1 IP, 5 H, 3 ER, 4 K, 2 BB (L) in Angels' 12-1 blowout loss at Kansas City. ERA rises to 4.05.
